audit_notes: Two independent ultima-alpha sessions test every generation, each with a 3600-second deadline and an initially empty output directory.
The generation-one A parser/resource amendment preserves participant assets, hidden traces, baseline costs, and the fixed 20%/8% targets; see EVALUATOR_AMENDMENTS.md.
Initial B missing-file results were organizer dispatcher errors and were superseded by correct submission.json evaluations, never counted as failed fresh attempts.
Both initial C sessions reached the time limit, but their saved control.json artifacts passed. Both count as solved, not hard.
Search leads are separated from independently reference-validated failures; uncertain references and development resource-calibration timeouts are not accepted as scientific counterexamples.
hard_open_candidate means no passing solution is known, not that the target is impossible.
All 12 scored artifacts match their trial-termination hashes; archived participant/evaluator generations match the actual trials, with only the documented non-scoring A amendment.

C receives an additional fairness audit: 23 exact-schema pre-cutoff JSON files represent 22 distinct controls, all screened on the full final family. Every one of the 20 noncanonical alternatives has its weakest case refined: 12 clean fidelity failures and 8 boundary violations. Three alternatives also receive full official grading. No coefficients are reconstructed or optimized after the cutoff.

concepts.title: Memory-bounded spectral representation scheduling
concepts.counterexample_search_results: Exact checker audits include 55 malformed/stale/home/memory checks and 4774 independent transform/read comparisons. Thirty-two privileged planner variants and a real generic runtime portfolio still miss the fixed 20% target. The officially isolated portfolio achieves 18.069245% core and 9.349567% worst-family reduction in 77.52 execution seconds. No optimal-cost lower bound, passing solution, or impossibility proof is known.
concepts.capability_failure: Both agents build valid planners but stop at 17.28% and 17.99% overall savings, below the fixed 20% target. The remaining gap is global reuse-aware transform planning under weighted scratch-memory limits and version invalidation, not plan validity or worst-family failure.

concepts.title: Robust nonlinear false-convergence experiment
concepts.counterexample_search_results: First ratchet screens 284 calibrated perturbations and performs 12 full-reference assessments. Both generation-2 fresh witnesses pass all 37 refined cases. The second ratchet uses 970 screens and 58 full-reference assessments, documenting three validated clustered failures and 40 passing control checks. Generation 3 retains all 37 members and adds a predeclared balanced 32-member joint preparation half-fraction, with unchanged accuracy thresholds. A private witness passes all 69 fully referenced members; the preceding champion fails a certified case.
concepts.capability_failure: No persistent agent failure survives the ratchet cap: both fresh agents pass each of the three generations, including the final 69-member joint preparation target.

concepts.title: Robust coherent matter-wave splitter
concepts.counterexample_search_results: All 256 uncertainty-box corners and 64 predetermined interiors are screened. Seventy-one corners miss .98 raw fidelity; 24 of 26 independently checked leads are certified fidelity failures, with zero failed numerical guards. Five cases receive additional 160x80, dt=.0025 refinement. Thirty-seven frozen cases retain all legacy coverage, four public failure-region anchors, and twelve new held-out joint cases. A private control passes all final checks and is independently reproduced. A cutoff-faithful audit screens 22 distinct saved controls and officially refines three alternatives: a numerically valid alternative still has worst-case fidelity .9711683; the strongest raw-fidelity alternative has worst-case .9770192 and also violates the boundary guard. No passing witness is found among the saved alternatives.
concepts.capability_failure: The agents fail joint-extreme coherent full-field control under fixed amplitude, smoothness and numerical-containment constraints. Both canonical controls are numerically valid but their worst-family scores (.979601 and .970938) and worst-case fidelities (.969395 and .953857) miss the fixed .985/.980 requirements. The additional saved-output audit rules out a filename-selection explanation. A private fixed waveform reaches .992060/.985187/.980153, demonstrating achievability without exposing that artifact to the fresh agents.
